name: Overhead triceps extension
notes: Seated or standing, one dumbbell held in both hands. Record the load of the dumbbell.

guide.setup: Sit or stand tall holding one dumbbell overhead in both hands with the upper arms close to the ears.
guide.execution: Lower the dumbbell behind the head by bending the elbows, then extend until the arms are straight overhead.
guide.cues: Keep ribs down. Keep the upper arms still. Control the stretch behind the head.
guide.mistakes: Elbows flaring wide; arching the lower back; shortening the range; letting the upper arms drift forward.
